# GSAP

GSAP 3.13.0, distributed unchanged from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.13.0.tgz

The original copyright and license notice is retained in gsap.min.js.
License terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/GSAP/Timeline/

No plugins are included. The runtime is local so the film does not need a CDN during playback.
